data.one_liner: A simple player plugin for system default ringtones, alarms and notifications.
data.what_it_does: Plays system default ringtones, alarms, and notifications on Android and iOS. Supports looping, volume adjustment, playing as an alarm to ignore silent mode, and custom ringtones from assets or file paths.
use_when: You need to trigger system ringtones, alarms, or notification sounds in your app.
You want to play short audio alerts or custom audio from assets or files with minimal setup.
avoid_when: You need a complex music player or full audio streaming capabilities.
You need cross-platform support outside of Android and iOS.
strengths: Simple API to play standard system sounds instantly.
Supports looping, volume settings, and bypassing silent mode on Android.
Allows custom audio playback from assets and files.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
Some advanced features like looping and volume control have platform or API level restrictions.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a more full-featured audio playback solution for playing multiple audio files, streams, or more complex sound effects.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a feature-rich, highly customizable audio player with support for playlists, looping, and precise positioning.
